CustomPreset.toggleButtonNameHint: A button with this name appears above the input. Give several prompts the same name and one button turns them all on.
CustomPreset.toggleButtonNameHintAdvance:
· Put this prompt on several buttons → list names with commas (e.g. Low, Mid, High)
· Buttons you pick just one of → give them the same tag (e.g. level::Low, level::Mid)
   → Turning "Mid" on turns "Low" off automatically. The tag is not shown on the button.
· Too many buttons? Collapse them → give them the same folder (e.g. staging>>Lighting, staging>>Camera)
   → Only a "staging" button appears on the bar, and several can be on at once in the list it opens.
· A folder and a tag combine (e.g. staging>>level::Low) — Low/Mid stay exclusive inside the collapsed list.

CustomPreset.enableCollapseToggleNote: Shows the collapse/expand button for the quick toggle bar above the input.
CustomPreset.enablePositionSelectNote: Select position when adding prompts, and change position in the editor.

CustomPreset.enableToggleGroupNote: Shows the "Manage Groups" feature that bundles several prompts into one button.
CustomPreset.toggleGroupManageTitle: Bundle several prompts into a single toggle button.
CustomPreset.toggleGroupDesc:
Create a group and pick the prompts to include. One button then turns them all on or off. A prompt can belong to several groups.
Give groups a tag to keep only one of them on, or a folder to collapse them into one button that can hold several on at once.

CustomPreset.enablePromptPreviewNote: Adds a menu to preview the fully assembled prompt that will be sent, shown as cards.
CustomPreset.promptPreviewNeedChat: Please open a character and a chat first.
CustomPreset.promptPreviewModeDryHint: Assembled without sending · excludes interceptor (RAG, etc.) injections
CustomPreset.promptPreviewModeLiveHint: The actually sent prompt · includes interceptor injections

CustomPreset.promptPreviewArmTitle: Click to capture the next send

CustomPreset.enablePromptCaptureNote: Send code blocks or selected text from chat messages straight into a preset prompt.

CustomPreset.captureFromSelectionNote: Shows a capture button when you select text inside a chat message.
CustomPreset.captureMacroDefaultNote: Starts the capture dialog with the {{user}}/{{char}} conversion checked. You can change it per capture.
CustomPreset.captureUseMacroNote: Toggling this recomputes the text below from the original. (Manual edits are lost)

CustomPreset.captureExistingHint: You can edit this directly. With "At the cursor", the text goes in exactly where you place the caret, as-is.
CustomPreset.captureNoPrompts: This preset has no prompts to capture into.
CustomPreset.enableKeywordTriggerNote: Adds a "Keyword" entry to the Triggers list in the prompt editor. Prompts that pick it are only included when a keyword shows up in the recent chat.
CustomPreset.keywordTriggerGlobalDepthNo: How many messages to scan back from the end when a prompt does not set its own depth.
CustomPreset.keywordTriggerMarkerWarn: ⚠ This entry is a marker. On turns with no keyword hit, the whole block it stands for (world info, character fields, ...) is left out.
CustomPreset.keywordTriggerListHint: Same as a lorebook: comma separated, and /regex/i entries work as-is (commas inside them are kept).
CustomPreset.keywordTriggerCaseNote: Applies to plain keywords only. A regex follows its own flags (/.../i).
CustomPreset.keywordTriggerDepthHint: How many messages to scan back from the end. With a narrower scan target, only those messages are counted.
CustomPreset.keywordTriggerEmptyWarn: With no keywords at all, the prompt fires unconditionally.
